tables.name: Eladrin Naming Method — Genderless Seasonal Courts
tables.description: All names use ONE shared genderless given-name pool. Seasons are naming aesthetics, not gender and not a forced character season. 24% Spring, 24% Summer, 24% Autumn, 24% Winter, 4% Unbound. Each d100 method routes to one fixed d100 given-name table and one fixed d100 family/court table.
